description: Births to and deaths of New York City residents (five boroughs), from NCHS Vital Statistics of the United States annual volumes. Births: Vol. I Natality, Table 2-1 (Section 2, Local Area Statistics), column "Births by place of residence - Total births". Deaths: Vol. II Mortality Part B, Table 7-1 (8-1 in 1979-80), column "Deaths by place of residence - Total deaths". Every value double-read from high-resolution crops and checked two ways: five borough rows sum exactly to the city row, and White + All other sum exactly to the city row.
